On Tuesday we publish our projects to Posit Connect Cloud. The steps are the same for Shiny apps and Quarto reports, and we cover some tips for authoring reports in Quarto. On Thursday we look at Shiny modules for those building apps. Both sessions end with studio time: peer feedback and dry runs to get your project ready for the final session.

::: {.callout-note}
Building an app? [Styling Your App](/modules/module-6.1.qmd) and [Troubleshooting Your App](/modules/module-6.1.qmd) are optional reference material for polishing and debugging.
:::
